_comment: Campus config. `areas` = freeform [lon,lat] polygons used ONLY to classify which region a place/edge is in (point-in-polygon); they do NOT limit routing. `bounds` = the overall Duke extent (one bbox [south,west,north,east]) used for the OSM fetch + basemap so the graph is one connected network you can route across. Edit areas via `npm run bbox`.

bounds._comment: Overall Duke extent [south,west,north,east]; union of areas + ~200m margin. Replace with a tighter drawn boundary if desired.
